blocks.prompt: 2. A rectangular sheet of metal with dimensions 40 cm by 25 cm is to be made into an open box by cutting equal squares from the corners and folding up the sides. Find the size of the squares that maximize the volume.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh maximum volume ka sawal hai: aik sheet se khula dabba banana hai jis mein sab se zyada cheez aaye.
Diya kya hai? 40 cm by 25 cm ki sheet; chaaron konon se barabar squares kaat kar kinare upar mor dene hain.
Find kya karna hai? Squares ki side \(x\) kitni ho ke dabbe ka volume sab se zyada ho.
Rule kaunsa? Volume = lambai × chaurai × oonchai ko \(x\) mein likh kar \(V'(x) = 0\) aur second derivative test.
Plan: jo root \(0 < x < 12.5\) se bahar ho use chhor denge, kyun ke woh asal mein kaata hi nahi ja sakta.
steps:
Diya gaya: sheet 40 cm by 25 cm; chaaron konon se barabar squares kaatne hain; dabba upar se khula hai.
Maloom karna: squares ki woh side jis se volume sab se zyada ho.
Tareeqa: volume ko \(x\) ka function bana kar first aur second derivative test.

Dabbe ki dimensions \(x\) mein
\[\text{length} = 40 - 2x, \quad \text{width} = 25 - 2x\]
\[\text{height} = x\]
Kyun: har lambi side ke dono siron se \(x\) kat jata hai, is liye \(2x\) kam hota hai. Jo flap upar mura woh \(x\) ooncha hai, wahi dabbe ki oonchai hai. Teeno positive honi chahiye, is liye \(0 < x < 12.5\) (kyun ke \(25 - 2x > 0\)).
Dhyan dein: lambai \(40 - x\) likhna aam ghalti hai; kat dono taraf se hota hai.

Volume
\[V = x(40 - 2x)(25 - 2x)\]
\[= x(1000 - 80x - 50x + 4x^{2})\]
\[V = 4x^{3} - 130x^{2} + 1000x \quad \text{...(1)}\]
Kyun: pehle brackets khol diye taa ke har term par seedha power rule lag sake. Pehle \((40 - 2x)(25 - 2x)\) ko multiply kiya (har term ko har term se), phir poore ko \(x\) se. Product rule se bhi kar sakte the, lekin teen factors ke saath woh lamba ho jata hai.

Critical points
\[\dfrac{dV}{dx} = 12x^{2} - 260x + 1000 \quad \text{...(2)}\]
\[3x^{2} - 65x + 250 = 0\]
\[(x - 5)(3x - 50) = 0\]
\[x = 5 \ \text{ ya } \ x = \dfrac{50}{3}\]
Kyun: poori equation ko 4 se divide kiya. Phir middle term ko todha: \(-65x = -15x - 50x\), kyun ke \(3 \times 250 = 750 = 15 \times 50\). Is se \(3x(x - 5) - 50(x - 5)\) bana.

Na-mumkin root ko chhor dein
\(x = \frac{50}{3} \approx 16.67\) range \(0 < x < 12.5\) mein nahi.
Kyun: is se chaurai \(25 - 2x\) negative ho jati hai. 25 cm ki side se 16.67 cm ke do squares kaise katenge? Mumkin hi nahi. Is liye sirf \(x = 5\) bacha.

Second derivative test
\[\dfrac{d^{2}V}{dx^{2}} = 24x - 260\]
\[x = 5 \text{ par}: \ 120 - 260 = -140 < 0\]
Kyun: negative hai, is liye \(x = 5\) par volume maximum hai.

Maximum volume aur tasdeeq
\[V = 5(40 - 10)(25 - 10)\]
\[= 5 \times 30 \times 15 = 2250\text{ cm}^{3}\]
Parosi values check karein: \(x = 4\) se \(4 \times 32 \times 17 = 2176\), aur \(x = 6\) se \(6 \times 28 \times 13 = 2184\). Dono 2250 se kam hain, to jawab sahi hai. Ghor kijiye: chhote squares kaatein to dabba chapta (kam ooncha) banta hai, bare kaatein to base chhota ho jata hai; 5 cm in dono ke darmiyan behtareen tawazun (balance) hai.
blocks.final_answer: Konon se 5 cm side ke squares kaatne chahiyein. Dabba 30 cm × 15 cm × 5 cm banega aur us ka maximum volume \(2250\text{ cm}^{3}\) hoga.
